text:
maya: FYI customer reported invoice shows ~18k extra token units vs their dashboard, they say this started after last network outage. invoice: INV-2026-9071. can we triage?
samira: assigning. customer on private VPC using meter-agent v1.3.7, host tz appears to be Europe/Zurich. any immediate checks?
jordan: first guess is clock skew + offline buffering causing replay bursts. ask customer for /var/log/redwood/meter-agent.log and audit ledger tail.
maya: pasted relevant log excerpt below from agent on node-2:
```
2026-11-07T02:13:21Z INFO buffer: queued 1248 events (offline_mode=true)
2026-11-07T02:13:21Z INFO last_seq=1298320 last_sent_seq=1296704
2026-11-07T05:23:05+03:00 WARN system clock changed: delta=3h9m44s
2026-11-07T05:23:07Z INFO flush: sending 1248 events (replay=true) start_seq=1296705 end_seq=1297952
```
maya: note log timestamps: some lines Z vs +03:00, looks like TZ mismatch. customer says they saw a FOLLOWUP of duplicate tokens on dashboard when agent came back online.
alex: that flush window + timezone shift looks suspicious. audit ledger shows the same client_id with overlapping seq ranges. duplicates would inflate invoice while dashboard (near-real-time) de-dupes when processing, so that could explain invoice > dashboard.
ryan: can we confirm whether agent uses monotonic seq vs wallclock? v1.3.7 had a bug where seq wrap detection failed when host clock jumped forward >2h. we fixed in 1.4.x.
samira: steps to repro/check (ping to customer):
1) collect /var/log/redwood/meter-agent.log (tail -n 500)
2) run on agent host: `ntpstat || chronyc tracking` and `date --iso-8601=seconds`
3) run `sudo grep client_id=ACME123 /var/log/redwood/audit.log | awk '{print $NF}' | uniq -c | sort -nr | head` to spot dup seq ranges
4) run reconcile tool: `/opt/redwood/bin/reconcile-meter --ledger /data/ledger --dedupe-by seq,client_id --output /tmp/recon.csv`
jordan: quick mitigation: ask customer to set ENABLE_STRICT_SEQ=true in /etc/redwood/meter-agent.conf and restart agent to stop replays until we patch. also schedule NTP fix.
metering-bot: ALERT: ticket #SUP-4392 linked -> runbook: https://runbook.internal/redwood/metering/replay-duplicates. recommended patch: agent v1.4.2 (contains seq-safety and idempotency markers).
alex: if they can let us run reconcile we can compute delta and produce an invoice adjustment pre-check. script to build provisional delta:
```
python3 -c "# pseudo
# parse /tmp/recon.csv, sum duplicates where flagged, print token delta"
```
maya: ordering for next steps: ask customer for logs + permission to restart agent in a 15m maintenance window, push config change ENABLE_STRICT_SEQ, run reconcile, if delta > $50 escalate billing ops.
samira: I'll message customer, include runbook links and ask for the window.
maya: customer ok for maintenance at 2026-11-07 19:00 UTC. I'll do restart and upload logs post-restart.
jordan: after logs come in I'll run the reconcile and share recon.csv. if we confirm replayed-seqs we build credit for overlapped tokens and propose invoice correction. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all — updating ticket SUP-4392 and attaching above log snippet.
